verify_note: Delete: the old story's scene (supermarket the day after 9/11) and its claims could not be found in any source. What the book does support is the practice 'Hold hands. With strangers.' and being present in joy and pain, but sources give no case or mechanism beyond that, and Brown's use of Durkheim and Ehrenreich is unconfirmed. Not enough book-grounded material for an honest story of the minimum length; the idea is touched in 1645.
